_doc: Kartrummet, fliken World (docs/terrain.md, steg 1): spakarna, de färdiga landskapen och vyerna. Generatorn är shared/terrain/generate.js (brus, form, terrasser, erosion), marken byggs med shared/terrain/field.js och havet är shared/effects/water.js. Världen är 256 m–4 km i fyrkant (worldSize) med högst 1025 × 1025 hörn. Grupper med "step" hör till ett steg (regions till Regions, climate till Biomes; brush används av båda). channelKinds är vattnet man gräver i steget Sculpt (shared/terrain/sculpt.js): halva bredden från start till slut (m), djupet (a + b · bredd), hur långt under marken ytan ligger (drop), bankens rundning och vallen; sea: ytan i havets nivå (en vik). regionThemes är regionernas teman (klimat som tillägg eller faktorer på världens spakar, biomernas vikter, färgton på växtligheten och väder för Explore), regionParams spakarna per region och regionColors kartfärgerna, i shared/terrain/regions.js. Färdiga världar kan ha en lista regions. biomes är biomernas namn och färger, i samma ordning som shared/terrain/biomes.js. Spakar med "recipe": false (vyn, himlen och penseln) sparas inte; sparade landskap hamnar i assets/terrain/<namn>.terrain.json. Texten i appen är på engelska. sculptTools är penslarna i Sculpt med sina egna förval (defaults), sculptParams spakarna i kortet Brush (tools: vilka penslar som har spaken; stamp: bara med ett mönster), sculptStamps penselmönstren och sculptLandforms landformerna som trycks ut med ett klick (shared/terrain/stamps.js; blend add eller max, base ground eller sea).

params.label: World size

options.label: 256 m
options.help: A test site: quick to build, 0.5 m between the corners

options.label: 512 m
options.help: A small island or valley, 0.5 m between the corners

options.label: 1 km
options.help: An island for a game level, 1 m between the corners

options.label: 2 km
options.help: A large island, 2 m between the corners

options.label: 4 km
options.help: A whole world, 4 m between the corners (the close view needs the coming Explore step)

params.help: How large the world is. The grid always has at most 1025 × 1025 corners, so larger worlds are coarser up close

params.label: Shape

options.label: Island
options.help: Land that falls toward the sea on every side, with an irregular shore

options.label: Volcano
options.help: A cone with a crater at the top and ravines down its sides, the sea around it

options.label: Atoll
options.help: A ring of low islands around a shallow lagoon, with gaps in the ring

options.label: Twin isles
options.help: Two islands with a strait between them

options.label: Crescent bay
options.help: An island with a large, sheltered bay that opens to the sea

options.label: Archipelago
options.help: Many islands where the low noise rises above the sea, sparser outward

options.label: Coast
options.help: Land in the distance, the sea in front

options.label: Open land
options.help: Only the noise: hills, mountains, plains or highlands

options.label: Valley
options.help: Two ridges with a wide, winding valley floor between them

options.label: Canyon
options.help: A high plateau cut by a deep, winding gorge with steep walls

params.help: The overall form the noise is laid into

params.label: Seed
params.help: Another seed gives another landscape with the same character

params.label: Height
params.help: The height of the highest land, in metres

params.label: Feature size
params.help: How large the hills are, in metres: small values give many small hills

params.label: Shore
params.help: Where the island's shore runs, as a share of the half-width of the world

params.label: Detail levels
params.help: How many finer layers of noise lie on top of each other

params.label: Roughness
params.help: How much the finer layers weigh: low is soft and rounded, high is rough and rocky

params.label: Ridges
params.help: Sharp mountain ridges that branch (ridged noise) instead of round hills

params.label: Swirl
params.help: How much the shapes wind and swirl (domain warp), in metres

params.label: Terraces
params.help: Steps in the land: plateaus and bands of cliffs (0 = none)

params.label: Terrace edges
params.help: How flat the steps are and how sharp their edges

params.label: Rain erosion
params.help: Drops that run downhill, carve gullies and leave sediment in the valleys

params.label: Scree angle
params.help: Slopes steeper than this angle crumble (degrees; 0 = off)

params.label: Sea
params.help: Water at sea level around the land

params.label: Sea level
params.help: The height of the sea, in metres

params.label: Snow line
params.help: Snow above this height, in metres

params.label: Beach
params.help: How high above the sea the sand reaches, in metres

params.label: Cliff angle
params.help: Steeper than this shows bare rock (degrees)

params.label: Grass
params.help: From dry and golden to lush and green

params.label: Border width
params.help: How wide the blend between two regions is (metres): narrow gives a clear border, wide a slow change

params.label: Wandering
params.help: How much the borders wind and bulge instead of running straight

params.label: Natural borders
params.help: How much the borders follow the land: ridges, streams and the sea between islands

params.label: Tree line
params.help: Above this height (metres) the trees stop and bare mountain begins; pine forest grows just below it

params.label: Rainfall
params.help: How wet the world is: dry gives heath and open meadow, wet gives forest and marshes

params.label: Forest
params.help: How much of the green land is forest, in groves with clearings between them

params.label: Marshes
params.help: Marshes in flat, wet hollows and valley floors

params.label: Coastal wind
params.help: How far in from the shore the wind keeps trees away (metres): heath and grass along the coast

params.label: Brush size
params.help: The radius of the brush, in metres (sculpting, regions and biomes)

params.label: Strength
params.help: How strong each stroke is: how much it raises, smooths or paints

params.label: View

options.label: Shaded
options.help: The land with its ground layers, sun and shadows

options.label: Regions
options.help: The regions in flat colours, darker along the borders where they blend

options.label: Biomes
options.help: The biomes as flat colours: beach, meadow, forest, pine, marsh, heath, rock and snow

options.label: Height
options.help: Colour by height: blue under the sea, green, brown and white up to the top

options.label: Slope
options.help: Colour by steepness: flat is dark, the cliff angle and steeper is red

options.label: Wetness
options.help: Where the rain ran (the erosion drops): dry is light, gullies and valleys blue

options.label: Wireframe
options.help: The triangles, to see the grid and how the diagonals follow the slopes

params.help: What the land shows: shaded, or a debug map

params.label: Weather
params.help: The weather from the Weather tab (ready-made and saved)

params.label: Time of day
params.help: The time of day (the weather's own time is replaced)

params.label: Sun direction
params.help: The compass direction of the sun

params.label: Haze
params.help: How much the air hazes the distance (share of the weather's own haze)

params.label: Exposure
params.help: Overall brightness (on top of the weather's own)

biomes.label: Beach
biomes.help: Sand along the shore and under the shallow sea

biomes.label: Meadow
biomes.help: Open grassland with flowers; what grows where nothing else does

biomes.label: Forest
biomes.help: Broadleaf forest in groves, on moist lowland

biomes.label: Pine forest
biomes.help: Conifers higher up, toward the tree line

biomes.label: Marsh
biomes.help: Wet, flat hollows and valley floors

biomes.label: Heath
biomes.help: Dry or wind-swept land: heather, low shrubs and golden grass

biomes.label: Rock
biomes.help: Cliffs and bare mountain above the tree line

biomes.label: Snow
biomes.help: Above the snow line, where the slopes are gentle enough

temperate.label: Green vale
temperate.help: The world's own climate: meadows, groves and heath as the sliders say

woodland.label: Deep woods
woodland.help: Wetter, with much more forest and fewer open meadows

pinewood.label: Pine highlands
pinewood.help: Cool and high: pine instead of broadleaf, and a lower tree line

wetland.label: Fens
wetland.help: Wet lowland: marshes in every hollow, reeds and dark green

steppe.label: Golden steppe
steppe.help: Dry and open: heath and golden grass, few trees

autumn.label: Autumn wood
autumn.help: Broadleaf forest in autumn colours, warm and golden

highland.label: Windswept highlands
highland.help: Open moor: heath and rock, a low tree line and strong wind from the sea

gloom.label: Gloomwood
gloom.help: A dark, haunted forest: dense trees, grey-green ground and mist

frost.label: Frostlands
frost.help: Cold: snow comes far down, pine and bare rock, pale ground

ashland.label: Ashlands
ashland.help: Burnt and barren: rock and dry heath, almost no meadow or forest

regionParams.label: Rain
regionParams.help: Wetter or drier than the theme says

regionParams.label: Forest
regionParams.help: More or less forest than the theme says

regionParams.label: Tree line
regionParams.help: Raise or lower the tree line in this region (metres)

regionParams.label: Tone
regionParams.help: The plants' colour: dry and golden (left) or lush and green (right)

stream.label: Stream
stream.help: A small winding stream: click points from the spring towards the sea, double-click to finish. Its surface only runs downhill

river.label: River
river.help: A wide river with low banks: click points along its course, double-click to finish

bay.label: Bay
bay.help: An inlet from the sea: click from the open water into the land, double-click to finish. It is widest at the sea and fills with sea water

sculptTools.label: Raise
sculptTools.help: Lift the land under the brush; hold and drag. Ctrl lowers instead

sculptTools.label: Lower
sculptTools.help: Sink the land under the brush. Ctrl raises instead

sculptTools.label: Smooth
sculptTools.help: Even out bumps and sharp edges (hold Shift with any brush to smooth)

sculptTools.label: Flatten
sculptTools.help: Level the land to the height where you pressed, or to a fixed height (Alt+click picks it): a plateau for a village

sculptTools.label: Ramp
sculptTools.help: Drag from one point to another: an even slope between their heights, as wide as the brush

sculptTools.label: Noise
sculptTools.help: Rough up the land with small hills and hollows

sculptTools.label: Terrace
sculptTools.help: Step the land into flat ledges with short slopes between them, like old fields or cliff bands

sculptTools.label: Erode
sculptTools.help: Rain on the land under the brush: water carves gullies and leaves fans of soil where it slows

sculptParams.label: Size
sculptParams.help: The radius of the brush, in metres ([ and ] change it)

sculptParams.label: Strength
sculptParams.help: How much each touch of the brush does

sculptParams.label: Hardness
sculptParams.help: The falloff: soft (left) fades from the middle like a dome, hard (right) works fully almost to the edge

sculptParams.label: Spacing
sculptParams.help: How far apart the touches are along a stroke, in parts of the brush: close gives an even stroke, wide a dotted one

sculptParams.label: Follow stroke
sculptParams.help: Turn the pattern with the direction you drag in

sculptParams.label: Scatter
sculptParams.help: A random angle and size for each touch, so a pattern does not repeat

sculptParams.label: Fixed height
sculptParams.help: Flatten to the height below instead of where you press (Alt+click on the land picks it)

sculptParams.label: Height
sculptParams.help: The height Flatten levels to, in metres

sculptStamps.label: Round
sculptStamps.help: The plain brush: a soft dome

sculptStamps.label: Mound
sculptStamps.help: A rounded hill with an uneven surface

sculptStamps.label: Crater
sculptStamps.help: A sunken middle with a raised rim

sculptStamps.label: Ridge
sculptStamps.help: A long ridge along the brush's angle

sculptStamps.label: Mesa
sculptStamps.help: A flat top with steep edges

sculptStamps.label: Terraces
sculptStamps.help: Three steps up to a flat top

sculptStamps.label: Boulders
sculptStamps.help: A few round boulders of different sizes

sculptStamps.label: Dunes
sculptStamps.help: Waves across the brush: a gentle side and a steep side

sculptStamps.label: Gullies
sculptStamps.help: Parallel furrows along the brush, where rain has run

sculptLandforms.label: Mountain
sculptLandforms.help: A whole mountain: a peak with ridges and ravines. Click once where it should stand

sculptLandforms.label: Volcano
sculptLandforms.help: A cone with a crater at the top and furrows down its sides

sculptLandforms.label: Island
sculptLandforms.help: An island rising out of the sea with hills and an uneven coast; click in the water

sculptLandforms.label: Mountain range
sculptLandforms.help: A row of peaks along the brush's angle

sculptLandforms.label: Canyon
sculptLandforms.help: A winding canyon with steep, stepped walls along the brush's angle

landformParams.label: Size
landformParams.help: The radius of the landform, in metres

landformParams.label: Height
landformParams.help: How high it rises (or how deep a canyon goes), in metres

landformParams.label: Rotation
landformParams.help: The angle of the landform (degrees), for ranges and canyons

landformParams.label: New each click
landformParams.help: A new variant every time you click; off repeats the same one
